mapper.sql: id, room_id, check_item_id, room_type, status, ai_overall, ai_score, ai_reason, photo_object_key, photo_url, judge_fingerprint, human_override_emp_no, human_override_reason, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_vision_check_record ( room_id, check_item_id, room_type, status, ai_overall, ai_score, ai_reason, photo_object_key, photo_url, judge_fingerprint, human_override_emp_no, human_override_reason, created_by ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{checkItemId}, #{roomType}, #{status}, #{aiOverall}, #{aiScore}, #{aiReason}, #{photoObjectKey}, #{photoUrl}, #{judgeFingerprint}, #{humanOverrideEmpNo}, #{humanOverrideReason}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cps_vision_check_record WHERE judge_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND status IN ('AI_PASS', 'AI_FAIL', 'HUMAN_OVERRIDE') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM cps_vision_check_record WHERE judge_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_vision_check_record SET ai_overall = #{aiOverall}, ai_score = #{aiScore}, ai_reason = #{aiReason}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'AI_JUDGING'
